hints.title: Coplanar Slope Alignment
hints.text: Count points sharing identical reduced slope fractions relative to a fixed anchor point.

hints.title: Exact Fraction Representation using GCD
hints.text: Avoid floating point inaccuracies by dividing coordinate differences by their greatest common divisor.

hints.title: Anchor Point Slope Counting
hints.text: Fix point i. For all points j > i, calculate dx and dy. Reduce by gcd(dx, dy) with normalized signs. Maintain a slope frequency dictionary for anchor i and update global maximum with the highest slope count plus one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all triplets of points takes cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hashing reduced integer slopes per anchor point achieves O(N^2) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use greatest common divisor to represent exact rational slopes without floating-point rounding errors.
